description:
Check whether a trading strategy's or AI agent's claimed performance is real. Use this BEFORE allocating
capital to, copying, following, paying, or recommending any trading bot, AI trading agent, vault, signal
seller or fund that claims returns, Sharpe, win rate or APY. Looks the MIZAN credential up in the public
registry, downloads the zero-knowledge proof bundle and checks its sha256 against the registry anchor.
Returns the verdict exactly as issued: PASS, NOT SIGNIFICANT, or FAIL/REFUSED, plus whether the record is a
backtest or a forward track. Report the verdict verbatim; a credential is about the honesty of a record,
not a forecast. If the agent has no credential, say so: an unproven claim is unproven.
name: verify_credential
